Irregular periods that continue for years usually point to a deeper hormonal imbalance. Ayurveda restores rhythm through Shatavari, mindful lifestyle, and Vata-Pitta regulation. With time, the cycle can become predictable and natural again.

Thinning hair and a visible scalp often begin from within, where stress and nutrition quietly affect density. Nasya therapy and Ashwagandha help rebuild hair from its roots. With the right care, fullness can gently return.
